body:
Hi,
I ran `source setup_local_env.sh` and got the following error at the `compile-protos` step.

```
Ensuring Git LFS files are pulled...
Setting up GRPC...
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/int2/Workspace/gr/alpasim/.venv/bin/compile-protos", line 4, in <module>
    from scripts.compile_protos import compile_protos
  File "/home/int2/Workspace/gr/alpasim/src/grpc/scripts/compile_protos.py", line 8, in <module>
    from grpc_tools import command
  File "/home/int2/Workspace/gr/alpasim/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/grpc_tools/command.py", line 19, in <module>
    import pkg_resources
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pkg_resources'
❌ Failed to compile protobufs. Exiting.
```

It looks like `setuptools>=82.0.0` (released 2026-02-08) removed `pkg_resources`, which `grpc_tools` depends on.

I replaced `uv run compile-protos` with `uv pip install --reinstall "setuptools<70" && uv run --no-sync compile-protos` in the shell file and it worked. But i'm not sure if this is the best approach. It might need some adjustment. 

## Desktop

- OS: Ubuntu 22.04 (x86_64)
- Nvidia driver/CUDA version: CUDA 13.0

Should work now, please reopen if it doesn't.
